note.en: Only better than a 635+ base ATK light cone from any path at S3+. If wanting to buff the selected DPS with ATK, use a high base ATK light cone from any path instead of Journey, Forever Peaceful

Majority of Preservation light cones do not have a high base ATK, therefore using any high base ATK light cone from any path works better. Prioritize 635+ base ATK light cones, ex. Acheron S1 - Along the Passing Shore. If lacking 635+ base ATK light cones, use any 582+ base ATK light cone from any path, ex. Himeko signature light cone, Night on the Milky Way.
Can be used with DoT team. Build to 75% EHR to receive a 100% ATK buff from Kafka's A2 Trace: Torture.
